prediction_text: Direction: the fugitive servant has gone westward, somewhat to the south (western sign, south quarter), and he shall return / be recovered rather than be lost for good. Mercury, peculiarly the servant's significator here, is in a western sign in the south quarter, and the servant's significator and lord of the Ascendant are hastening to a trine out of angles, a return/recovery application. Timing: soon, on a days scale — the hastening trine from angles gives a short interval after the preceding Sunday flight, within the coming days rather than months.
basis: Asc with lord and Moon therein for master; Mercury servant significator (Moon common significator of servants) in western sign south quarter, Moon at flight and still in western sign — direction west/south-west; Moon in 2nd in own house (Cancer) strong; Sun in 2nd in perfect aspect with planet in 11th; servant sig and Asc lord hastening to trine out of angles = return.
